text:
Sasha: quick sync — proposing a new 'Fogbank' adaptive reserve playbook for Dedicated capacity. Goal: combine slab-based reserve commitments + workload-adaptive microburst headroom so customers get predictable latency during surges without overpaying. feedback? :eyes:

TJ: nice name. high-level Q: how do slabs map to existing reserved pools? is this a replacement or an overlay?

Sasha: overlay. slabs are logical commitment bands (small/medium/large) that map to reserved pool sizing. The adaptive part adjusts the microburst headroom (%) based on recent seq-len and tail-latency signals.

Maria: on billing side we need clear semantics for "headroom consumption" vs committed usage. do we charge prewarm credits or bill overage? recommended: prewarm credits for transient microbursts, overage invoiced if sustained > window.

Ben: sketching a proto config for ops & canary: 
```yaml
reserve_policy:
  name: fogbank-v1
  slabs:
    - id: small
      min_tokens_per_min: 0
      max_tokens_per_min: 100k
      headroom_pct: 15
    - id: medium
      min_tokens_per_min: 100k
      max_tokens_per_min: 1M
      headroom_pct: 8
    - id: large
      min_tokens_per_min: 1M
      max_tokens_per_min: 10M
      headroom_pct: 4
autoscale:
  hysteresis_secs: 120
  canary_fraction: 0.05
  fallback_model_variant: small-fallback
```

Ben: headroom_pct is dynamic — telemetry agent adjusts it +/- 50% based on 95th pct tail-latency and kv-cache hit-rate.

infra-bot: deploy-checker: canary cluster fogbank-v1 scheduled to deploy tomorrow 03:00 UTC. CI green.

TJ: launch criteria proposals: 
- end-to-end p95 for slab customers < 350ms under 95th percentile load test
- sustained error rate < 0.5% for 72h in canary
- billing clarity doc + sample invoices published
- dashboard: per-slab token burn + headroom consumption stream

Julie: also add rollback triggers: if p99 increases > 20% from baseline or headroom consumption grows > 3x predicted in 30m, auto-rollback to previous reserve policy. we should also cap repeated rollbacks per day.

Maria: for customer asks — define an escape hatch: manual freeze of adaptive adjustments (button in Console) + opt-out to legacy fixed-commitment mode. legal needs language for refunds on incorrect overage billing.

Sasha: prioritization ask — core items to ship in alpha (4 weeks): 1) telemetry gating + headroom adjustment engine, 2) console toggle + billing semantics doc, 3) canary pipeline + rollback hooks. Secondary (8–12 weeks): self-serve slab sizing, predictive prewarm add-on, cross-region spillover.

TJ: resource asks from Eng: 2 FE, 2 BE, 1 infra, 1 SRE for canary + rollback, plus analytics for per-slab metrics.

Ben: ops note — we need simulated workload suite representing short microbursts (10s–2m), and long sustained tails (30m+). I'll start with synthetic traces.

Sasha: thanks — I'll add these deliverables to the roadmap, create a short PRD, and book a 30m huddle tomorrow. tagging @tj @ben @maria for review before PRD goes live. :thumbsup:

Julie: :thumbsup: small nit — ensure the PRD includes the exact metric names & aggregation windows used by SLOs (e.g., route.p95_5m, route.p99_1m).

infra-bot: reminder: post-deploy smoke test template -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fogbank-smoke

Sasha: copying notes to the alpha milestone and creating GH issue: #fogbank/alpha. will follow up with the huddle invite."
